She sank into silence. But cold like ice, that silence was not.

Her armour spoke first.

Ichijou"Minato, you bloody bastard...!"
Kageaki"If you cut me down, that is also acceptable."
Kageaki"Giving my answer to your justice is the last work left to me. That much I must finish. Nothing else is required."

Kageaki"I recognise your justice. This man who recognises it—cut him down."

Kageaki"Cruel things I am saying, na? Probably."
Kageaki"But the blood is already on your hands. The duty to know what fighting really is—you cannot run away from that!"
Ichijou"NAHIN! You're wrong!"

en.html:
Kageaki"............"
Ichijou"If what you're saying is true... then there is no justice in this whole world!"
Kageaki"...Follow the argument all the way, and yes. If justice means one single, absolute system of values, then such a thing does not exist."
Ichijou"It DOES! Father taught me..."
Ichijou"Don't deceive people! Don't take what is theirs! Don't oppress them! Reject evil and live rightly—that is justice! That is how a human being should live!"
Kageaki"Ethics? Social justice? In short: the majority has voted."
Kageaki"I am not dismissing it. But absolute truth? No. The votes cannot promote themselves to that post."
Ichijou"No! Aisa nahin... that's not..."
Kageaki"..."
Kageaki"Believe in justice. I will not stop you. That feeling is precious, I think."
Kageaki"Believe in justice and fight evil, also. That courage is precious too."

Kageaki"..."
Ichijou"I... I—"
Ichijou"I'll destroy evil and see justice through! I will NOT hide it! Hide it, and how am I supposed to put this world right?!"
Ichijou"How will Father's wish be fulfilled?! I am—I am—"
Ichijou"Ichijou Ayane! Nobody else will I become!!"
Kageaki"......................"
Ichijou"......................"
Kageaki"I see. Then—"
Kageaki"I also will remain Muramasa. The one who drags the ugliness of fighting into the open—that I will continue to be."
Kageaki"You, whom I consider right and precious—I will cut you down."
Ichijou"——!!"
Ichijou"...Betrayed me... This time, truly, you have—"
Ichijou"You've betrayed ME!"
Kageaki"...I am coming."
